coverage_definition: covered means mapped checks exercise the catalog requirement at its stated supported layer. This is coverage bookkeeping, not an execution record, release-gate pass, complete source inference or native approval. Historical observations are indexed in docs/contracts-evidence.md.

limitations: Tests witness the recorded compiler baseline. Architecture discovery, tool availability and historical command outcomes remain observations at their original revision, indexed in docs/contracts-evidence.md.
Unsupported historical versions reject. Incomplete cache dependencies require fresh analysis; no legacy format conversion or fabricated proof inputs are supported.
